title: Fixed Return-Bow Sheep Shears
description: One whole original fixed-open bow-style sheep shears visual prop. One continuous closed metal body passes from one broad leaf-shaped finite blunt blade through a rising narrow upright grip strip, around a large raised rear return bow, and down the opposing upright strip into the second broad blade. Its cross-section changes from low broad blade plates to tall thin band handles and return, with no center pivot, separate jaw attachments or finger-ring handles. Two constant opaque PBR face roles distinguish pale blade faces from dark return/grip band. One editable closed mesh, one prop and zero scenes. No actual spring force, shearing, sharpness, animal use, cutting cycle, ergonomics, manufacture or safety claim; static game-art shape only.
